overview: Musk's feed was dominated by xAI/SpaceX AI news: Grok Voice 3.0 launched at #1 on a speech-to-speech benchmark, and Amazon started blocking Grok Bot shopping agents. Tesla's Roadster event streams Thursday. Elsewhere, Chamath urged Anthropic to IPO fast as its implied valuation slid, and Google's Gemini 4 Argon topped a Scale AI benchmark.

top_items.title: Elon Musk - Grok Voice 3.0 debuts #1 on Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech index (86.9), priced at $0.08 per minute via API
Elon Musk - Tesla Roadster event streams live this Thursday at 7:55pm CST; Musk calls it a candidate for greatest product demo ever
Chamath Palihapitiya - Anthropic pre-IPO perpetual fell below $2T on Liquid, down 10%+ in a month; he says list at ~$1T and raise $200B
Elon Musk - Amazon now blocks Grok Bot agents as 'unauthorized AI agents'; Musk tells users to shop elsewhere
Demis Hassabis - Shared Scale AI's congrats to Gemini 4 Argon for taking the top spot on its Humanity's Sixth Sense benchmark
Brian Armstrong - Coinbase MCP now supports agentic trading of US perps, a day after users requested it through its feedback API
Elon Musk - Polymarket reports gasoline-only cars fell below 50% of global new vehicle sales for the first time
Elon Musk - Reposted Raymond James reiterating Strong Buy on $SPCX with a Street-high $800 price target, citing an FAA filing
